newsitem.title: CANADA: Imax wins Oscar for technical achievement.
newsitem.headline: Imax wins Oscar for technical achievement.

text.p: Imax Corp said on Monday that it won a 1997 Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences award for scientific and technical achievement.
The entertainment company said it won the Oscar statuette for its innovation in creating and developing a method of filming and exhibiting large-format motion pictures.

"We're honored to receive this prestigious award from the Academy which validates the innovation and commercial acceptance of IMAX technology," said Imax co-chief executive officers Bradley Wechsler and Richard Gelfond in a written statement.
The Oscar will be presented in an awards ceremony on March 1, 1997.
